exercises.instruction: Допишите предложения. Используйте слова из скобок (some/most и т. д.). Где необходимо, также вставьте of (some of / most of и т. д.).

parts: the shops in the city centre close at 6.30. (most)
people have mobile phones these days. (most)
the pictures in the living room. (any)
the film, but I didn’t like the ending. (most)
We can’t find anywhere to stay.
The weather was bad when we were on holiday. It rained

items.instruction: Посмотрите на картинки и ответьте на вопросы. Используйте: all/most/some/none + of them / of it

items.prompt: How many of the people are women?
How many of the boxes are on the table?
How many of the men are wearing hats?
How many of the windows are open?
How many of the people are standing?
How much of the money is Ben’s?

items.instruction: В некоторых предложениях допущена ошибка. Где нужно, исправьте ошибку.

items.prompt: Most of children like playing.
All the students failed the exam.
Some of people work too hard.
Some of questions in the exam were very easy.
answers: Some of the questions in the exam were very easy.
Some questions in the exam were very easy.

items.prompt: I haven’t seen any of those people before.
All of insects have six legs.
Have you read all these books?
answers: Have you read all of these books?

items.prompt: Most of students in our class are very nice.
answers: Most of the students in our class are very nice.
Most students in our class are very nice.

items.prompt: Most of my friends are going to the party.
I’m very tired this morning – I was awake most of night.
answers: I’m very tired this morning – I was awake most of the night.

items.instruction:
Переведите предложения на английский язык. [паук = spider
на экзамене = in the exam]

items.prompt: Большинство людей не любят пауков.
Я поняла большинство вопросов на экзамене.
answers: I understood most of the questions in the exam.

items.prompt: Некоторые люди не едят мясо.
Вчера мы познакомились с некоторыми Анниными друзьями.
answers: We met some of Anna’s friends yesterday.
Yesterday we met some of Anna’s friends.

items.prompt: Никто из нас не говорит по-итальянски.
answers: None of us can speak Italian.

items.prompt: Я не смотрел ни один из этих фильмов.
answers: I haven’t watched any of these films.
I haven’t seen any of these films.

items.prompt: "Вы знаете этих людей?" – "Большинство из них".
answers: ‘Do you know these people?’ ‘Most of them.’

items.prompt: "Кто ходил на вечеринку?" – "Мы все".
answers: ‘Who went to the party?’ ‘All of us.’
‘Who went to the party?’ ‘We all did.’
